items.detail: PatentTerminalParseError: Largan Family 83049877 item 1; paragraphs 46-62 and FIGS. 1-6 publish imaging assembly 1 with seven lens elements, manufacturing thickness, roughened-surface, glass-edge/central-thickness and release-force-ratio data. The exact source publishes no ordered optical radius, intersurface spacing, optical material/index/dispersion, surface-specific conic/asphere coefficients, identified stop coordinate, focal length, F-number or absolute image height. Manufacturing thicknesses, roughened surfaces and release-force ratios remain manufacturing/assembly architecture; the generic spherical/aspheric statement and aperture/stop list with omitted reference numerals do not create a prescription. Claims 1-20, including independent imaging-assembly claims 1/10 and dependent camera/electronic-device claims 19/20, add no separate ordered prescription. Paragraph 109's printed omission is not repaired. No value is derived, measured from drawings, transcribed from raster, or borrowed from prior publication US-20230408787-A1, Taiwan priority 111122121, another family or a shared layout
